faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NABCONS Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications for the NABCONS Project Assistant recruitment is 06 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before this date to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Regular Graduate and/or Post Graduation with 55% aggregate from a recognized University in any subject. Additionally, 3 years of experience in HR/Admin/Finance/Accounting/business development is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 35 years. There is no mention of minimum age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant role will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post in NABCONS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NABCONS Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Test (if required) followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NABCONS Project Assistant recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to fill out the application form through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of NABCONS.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
